title: NGOs Denounce Fast-Track Returns from Ceuta Ahead of Council of Ministers Decree-Law
detail: On the eve of the Sep 29 Council of Ministers, NGOs working in Ceuta criticised the planned decree-law and the returns already under way. Elín reported removals of Sudanese, Senegalese and Chadian nationals during asylum proceedings and triage documents issued in Spanish without translation; Border Resistance documented 14 Sudanese applicants returned to Morocco; No Name Kitchen described inadequate medical and interpreter access. Coverage also noted that eldiario.es sees the draft as pushing past the legal limits of the EU Pact on Migration and Asylum, while coalition partner Sumar maintains its opposition to cutting international-protection guarantees.
